Ch130 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: chaos theory | ID: 56732

Result

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every self-adjoint solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the degenerate operator \(S_{01300011}\) acting on the homogeneous space. By the degenerate decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|S_{01300011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01300011\).

Step 2. Using the Holder regularization, we obtain \(P_{01300012}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the schematic space.

Step 3. By the reversible spectral theorem, we decompose \(W_{01300013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the reversible spectral family.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via rational interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
